Neemias Queta.note: Queta (rest) won't play in Monday's game against the Magic, Taylor Snow of the Celtics' official site reports.

Jalen Smith.note: Smith (undisclosed) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 126-115 loss to the Cavaliers and did not return.

Patrick Williams.note: Williams (finger) has been ruled out for the remainder of Monday's game against Cleveland.

Tobe Awaka.note: Awaka (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Cavaliers.

Caleb Wilson.note: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Jaylon Tyson.note: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Chicago.

Peyton Watson.note: Watson left Monday's 126-115 win over Chicago due to a head injury and did not return.

Evan Mobley.note: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

Sam Merrill.note: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bulls.

Nae'Qwan Tomlin.note: Tomlin is set to miss several weeks with a lower back stress reaction, Chris Fedor of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

Julian Strawther.note: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Stephen Curry.note: Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Brandon Williams.note: Williams (hamstring) will miss at least one week, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

Kristaps Porzingis.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

Moses Moody.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Jimmy Butler III.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Amen Thompson.note: Thompson (knee) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

Marcus Smart.note: Smart has been suspended three games for throwing a punch during Wednesday's matchup against Golden State, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Steven Adams.note: Adams (calf) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

Clint Capela.note: Capela (ankle) is out for Monday's game against the Heat.

Julian Phillips.note: Phillips (illness) is available for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

Isaiah Stewart.note: Stewart is out for Monday's game against the Wizards due to an illness.

Ty Jerome.note: Jerome (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Wizards.

Scotty Pippen Jr..note: Pippen (back) is progressing in his recovery but is still considered week-to-week.

GG Jackson.note: Jackson will undergo surgery to repair the broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot and is set to miss significant time.

Richie Saunders.note: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Nikola Jovic.note: Jovic (illness) is out for Monday's game against Houston.

Bam Adebayo.note: Coach Erik Spoelstra stated after Monday's 128-110 win over Houston that the team held Adebayo (hip) out of the second half in an effort to be proactive, and the injury isn't expected to be a long-term issue, Anthony Chiang of the Miami Herald reports.

Pelle Larsson.note: Larsson won't play in Monday's game against the Rockets due to an illness, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

Jonathan Kuminga.note: Kuminga (shoulder) exited in the fourth quarter of Monday's 106-98 win over Portland and did not return. He closed with 13 points (5-12 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 2-2 FT), nine rebounds and one assist across 29 minutes.

Jaylen Clark.note: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

Anthony Edwards.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

Donte DiVincenzo.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

Bennedict Mathurin.note: Mathurin (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

Bryce McGowens.note: McGowens (elbow) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Warriors.

Trey Murphy III.note: Murphy (knees) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

Trendon Watford.note: Watford (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Golden State.

Dejounte Murray.note: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

Jonathan Isaac.note: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Celtics.

Noah Penda.note: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Paolo Banchero.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Izaiyah Nelson.note: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

LeBron James.note: James (back) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Nets.

Dominick Barlow.note: Barlow (back) will be re-evaluated later in the week and is thought to be nearing his 2026-27 season debut, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

Adem Bona.note: Bona (back) will be re-evaluated in approximately one week after seeing a specialist, Ky Carlin of USA Today reports.

Ariel Hukporti.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Mark Williams.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Chris Youngblood.note: Youngblood (foot) is out for Monday's game against the Timberwolves.

Vit Krejci.note: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

Ja Morant.note: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers Insider Sean Highkin reports.

Shaedon Sharpe.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Tristan Vukcevic.note: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Memphis.

Reece Beekman.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

Justin Champagnie.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

Jamir Watkins.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
